description:
Tired of chaotic grocery trips and always asking, "What's for dinner?" Stop juggling messy paper lists and endless texts. AnyList is the #1 app for busy families, couples, and anyone who wants to shop smarter and simplify weekly meal planning.

Finally, a shopping list that’s always in sync, a recipe box that’s always in your pocket, and a meal plan that everyone can see. It's the organization you've been craving.

Trusted by millions. As seen in The New York Times, Good Housekeeping, The Kitchn, and featured by Apple as one of "10 Essential Apps".

“Helped me save so much time, money, and mental energy” —Patty Catalano, The Kitchn
“Sets the standard for grocery list apps” —AppStorm
“Simple and intuitive” —Lifehacker

----

SHOP TOGETHER, EFFORTLESSLY

Instantly share your grocery list with your partner or roommates. Watch items get checked off in real-time as they shop — no more buying the same thing twice!

• BUILD LISTS IN SECONDS: Our smart autocomplete suggests items as you type.
• NEVER MISS A THING: Add a list to your home screen with our widgets, or add items with your voice using Siri and Alexa.
• SHOP YOUR WAY: Lists automatically sort into categories (Produce, Dairy, Deli, etc.) that can be re-arranged to match your store's layout, saving you time and steps.
• THE PERFECT ITEM, EVERY TIME: Add notes for brand, quantity, or even a photo to make sure you get exactly what you want.


YOUR COMPLETE RECIPE & MEAL PLANNING HUB

Stop searching through cookbooks and browser tabs. Organize all your favorite recipes in one place and turn them into shopping lists with a single tap.

• IMPORT IN A SNAP: Save recipes directly from your favorite blogs and websites.
• PLAN YOUR WEEK: Assign recipes to days on the meal planning calendar. Know what you're making and when.
• INSTANT SHOPPING LISTS: Add all ingredients from a recipe to your grocery list in one go.

Download for FREE and transform your grocery shopping and meal planning today!


UNLOCK THE FULL POWER OF ANYLIST COMPLETE

Ready to take your organization to the next level? Upgrade to AnyList Complete for the ultimate home management experience:

• AnyList on Your Desktop & Watch: Access your lists and recipes on your Mac, PC, and Apple Watch.
• Meal Planning Calendar: The easiest way to plan your family's meals for the week and create a perfectly coordinated shopping list.
• Import Recipes from the Web: Save recipes directly from thousands of recipe blogs and websites.
• Add Photos to Items & Recipes: End confusion at the store by adding a photo of the exact item you need.
• Stick to Your Budget: Add item prices as you shop to see your running total.
• Advanced Store Features: Assign items to specific stores, create location-based reminders, and filter your list on the fly.
• And so much more: Recipe scaling, list themes, passcode lock, and folders.


Join millions who have made shopping and meal planning stress-free. Get AnyList now!

For a full list of available features, check out our website: anylist.com/features

Got questions? We'd love to hear from you: team@anylist.com

AnyList includes icons from icons8.com.
